prompts.title: Q: What if security controls hurt UX?
prompts.answerMarkdown: **A:** Introduce risk-based controls (step-up auth, adaptive friction) and measure conversion + abuse outcomes.

prompts.title: Q: How do you prove the design works?
prompts.answerMarkdown: **A:** Define measurable success criteria: abuse rate, false positives, MTTD/MTTR, and red-team/purple validation cadence.

prompts.title: Q: What do you do during IdP outage?
prompts.answerMarkdown: **A:** Fail in controlled mode: bounded session extension, explicit emergency policy, full auditability.

prompts.title: Q: How do you prioritize roadmap items?
prompts.answerMarkdown:
**A:** By impact x exploitability x exposure, adjusted by implementation complexity and dependency risk.
